Interactive preview · web copy of the Swift logic

ローマ字・かな・辞書キーボード

Both keyboards from the iOS project, now with everything you need to use them all day. Type, and emoji are suggested (sushi → 🍣, ねこ → 🐈). Clear the text and the bar above the keys becomes a toolbar: emoji, 顔文字, GIF and your recent clipboard. No key ever moves.

Customise 設定

The same options as the app's Settings screen. Changes apply to the keyboard straight away. The typing ones are also in the keyboard: clear the text and tap ⚙︎.

Theme

iOS has no setting to make keyboards dark everywhere: each app picks light or dark and draws its frame to match. 藍, 桜 and 抹茶 change with it; 墨 and Custom don't, so give dark apps their own. Here, the page's light/dark mode stands in for the app's. (On iPhone, dark mode can also have its own custom colours, opacity and gradient.)

Custom colours

Changing a colour switches to the Custom theme.

ローマ字 · Mode key

Start in

A tap on the mode key steps through:

At least two stay on. Dragging from the key opens the mode wheel, which always has every mode. Left-handed swaps left and right (→ あ, ← EN). Other keyboards: 🌐 under the keyboard on iPhone. In 辞, the key next to return switches between looking words up and typing English straight in (with the Japanese shown as you type).

ローマ字 · Typing

Hold the space bar and slide to move the cursor (in Both keyboards below).

キー · Key extras

Swipe up on a key for the character in its corner, or hold it. Tap a key here to turn its extra off. ー holds 、。！？〜 (, . ! ? ~ in EN); keys with several choices keep the hold. In EN, holding a letter also offers accents.

候補 · Suggestions

Skin tone

Press delete straight after an autocorrection to undo it. On iPhone, suggestions use Apple's spell checker; this preview uses the 25,000 most common English words.

単語登録 · My words

    Words the keyboard doesn't know: type the reading and it comes first, and it's used inside longer phrases too. Phrases you convert a word at a time are remembered whole as well. On iPhone, iOS Text Replacements with a hiragana shortcut work too.

    ✨ AI

    Answered by

    Apple Intelligence (the default) runs on the iPhone, so it only answers there. Claude answers here too, with the same instructions; in the app it uses your own API key and needs Full Access.

    かな · Flick

    Sensitivity

    Both keyboards

    Animations: keys press in, the keyboard dips gently when the mode changes, and panels rise into place. Reduce Motion turns them off too. Romaji readings: 猫 ねこ neko. Haptics vibrate where the browser allows it (not Safari); on iPhone they need Full Access.
